meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会为NanoClaw添加Telegram频道支持:复制并注册Telegram适配器,安装固定版本的依赖包,运行构建和集成测试;之后用户提供bot令牌,用4位配对码绑定聊天。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 频道集成,或在 /setup 流程中选择添加 Telegram 频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 频道支持。
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 我要接入 Telegram bot,开始配置吧。
say.note: Claude 会引导你创建 bot 并获取令牌。

say.text: 为项目设置 Telegram 集成,然后配对聊天。
say.note: Claude 会注册适配器并进入配对流程。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds Telegram support by copying and registering the adapter, installing the pinned package, and running build + tests. Then the user supplies a bot token and pairs a chat with a 4-digit code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Telegram channel integration to NanoClaw, or selects adding a Telegram channel in the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Help me add Telegram channel support to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: I want to integrate a Telegram bot, let's start.
say_en.note: Claude helps you create the bot and get the token.

say_en.text: Set up Telegram integration for the project, then pair the chat.
say_en.note: Claude registers the adapter and starts the pairing process.
